project: Crop and Market Modal Price Forecasting
target_unit: Verify against source Price Unit; expected Rs./Quintal
forecast_horizon: One next available observation per Commodity-Market series
numeric_preprocessing: Use the saved x_scaler, fitted on training rows only, with numeric_features in the exact saved order.
target_preprocessing: Model output is scaled. Use the saved y_scaler.inverse_transform to convert predictions back to the original price scale.
categorical_preprocessing: Use saved category_maps. Map unseen categories to ID 0. Do not refit mappings during inference.
sequence_preprocessing: Sort observations by Commodity, Market, and Date.
Build sequences from the previous LOOKBACK observations.
Keep numerical and categorical sequence order aligned.
Reproduce the training notebook's engineered date and observation-gap features.
Do not use the target observation's actual Modal Price as an input.

engineered_features.Days_Since_Previous_Observation: Date difference from the previous observation within each Commodity-Market series; first observation uses 0.
engineered_features.Is_First_Observation: 1 for the first observation in a series, otherwise 0.
engineered_features.DayOfYear_Sin: Use the same annual cyclical formula as training.
engineered_features.DayOfYear_Cos: Use the same annual cyclical formula as training.
